Dracula Densetsu II.name: Castlevania II: Belmont's Revenge
Dracula Densetsu II.summary: Fifteen years after vanquishing the emperor of evil, Count Dracula, Christopher Belmont now faces a vampire swearing vengeance. Drac's back. And he's turned your son, Soleiyu Belmont, into a deadly demon to do his dirty deeds. Now not only do you have to rescue your kid from the Count's clutches, you have to first track him down in four creep packed Castles. Fortunately, you posses weapons like armor piercing Battle Axes, beast burning Holy Water, and the Legendary Mystic Whip. And you can increase your arsenal with power up items like Crystal Balls, Hearts, and Candles. Strap on your shield and step into the shadows. That is, if you're prepared for the dwellers of darkness.

Lemmings 2 - The Tribes.name: Lemmings 2: The Tribes
Lemmings 2 - The Tribes.summary: The Game Boy Port of Lemmings 2: The Tribes is a major downgrade due to the much less powerful hardware, and the support of only a d-pad makes controlling this game a challenge. The graphics are much worse and the view is much smaller. The music also gets rescored for the game boy soundchip which only supports basic chiptunes.

Phantom Air Mission.name: Phantom Air Mission
Phantom Air Mission.summary:
Scramble into the cockpit of the only combat jet fighter game on Game Boy! The Navy F-14 Tomcat, a hero of the Persian Gulf War, soars to new heights in this first-person aerial assault simulator.
* Fully instrumented control panels!
* HUD for enemy targeting; radar and landing displays for smooth navigation!
* Complete 360 rotation!
* Wing-mounted 50mm cannons; AIM-54 air-to-air missiles; ECM system to confuse oncoming warheads!
* Dynamic aircraft carrier takeoff and landing; in-flight refueling!

Punisher, The - The Ultimate Payback.name: The Punisher: The Ultimate Payback!
Punisher, The - The Ultimate Payback.summary: The Punisher: The Ultimate Payback is an Action game, developed by Beam Software and published by Acclaim, which was released in 1991.

Shippo de Bun.name: Tail 'Gator
Shippo de Bun.summary: Tail 'Gator is an Action game, developed and published by Natsume, which was released in 1991.

Super Donkey Kong 3.name: Super Donkey Kong 3
Super Donkey Kong 3.summary: Super Donkey Kong 3 is a Game Boy game based on Donkey Kong Country 3. It was created by Makon Soft at an unknown date.

Zettai Muteki Raijin-Oh.name: Zettai Muteki Raijin-Oh
Zettai Muteki Raijin-Oh.summary: This game is a one on one Mecha fighter where you control a giant robot straight out of a Japanese B movie and engage 8 equally giant creatures of darkness in mortal combat.
